title: Support Automator: shelllet extraction, staged validation, and debug telemetry
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a reusable "shelllet" extraction and validation pipeline that converts common admin runbook steps into idempotent, instrumented tasks for the runbook executor. This ticket covers extraction heuristics, staged validation (unit -> dryrun -> canary), debug-level telemetry for step-level failures, and an operator UI surface to resume/skip individual shelllets.
acceptance_criteria: Extraction tool produces a typed shelllet bundle from a raw runbook fragment that includes parameters, required secrets, and idempotency hints
Unit tests for extraction heuristics cover 90% of heuristic branches (prefix caching, mutable state detection, secret access)
Dryrun mode executes extracted shelllets against a sandbox environment with recorded diffs and no side effects
Canary rollout executes extracted shelllets on <=5% of support incidents with automatic rollback on assertion failures
Telemetry exports per-shelllet latency, token cost estimate, KV cache hits, and failure classification to Grafana/BigQuery
Operator console exposes resume/skip/inspect actions for in-flight shelllets and writes audit logs with provenance
